nodes.title: Unitary Operations and Reversibility
nodes.conceptSummary:
### 1. Pangkal Anomali
Di komputasi klasik kita terbiasa menghapus data dengan reset bit ke 0. Pendekatan ini runtuh di dunia kuantum karena penghapusan informasi menghasilkan disipasi panas termodinamika dan merusak ortogonalitas vektor keadaan.

### 2. Prototipe Intuitif
Bayangkan alih-alih perajang kertas yang menghancurkan lembaran dokumen, sistem kita adalah prisma cermin putar tanpa gesekan. Setiap berkas cahaya yang masuk dapat dikembalikan persis ke arah semula hanya dengan membalik arah putaran cermin.

### 3. Invarian & Operasi Inti
Invarian mutlak sistem adalah **Reversibilitas dan Preservasi Norma Vektor**. Tidak ada probabilitas yang boleh hilang atau bocor keluar dari sistem tertutup.

| Apa yang Dipikirkan Pemula (Salah) | Apa yang Sebenarnya Terjadi dalam Model Mental |
|---|---|
| Gerbang kuantum bebas menghapus status qubit menjadi nol. | Gerbang kuantum tertutup wajib uniter dan sepenuhnya reversibel tanpa disipasi entropi. |
| Pengurangan sudut vektor tidak mengubah

forwardPass.prompt: "Predict why an irreversible classical operation like bit-erasure (reset to 0) cannot be represented as an isolated quantum logic gate."

options.text: "Quantum operations must be unitary (U dagger U = I), which strictly preserves inner products and vector norms, guaranteeing 100% reversibility without entropy dissipation."
options.causalRationale: Correct: "Quantum operations must be unitary (U dagger U = I), which strictly preserves inner products and vector norms, guaranteeing 100% reversibility without entropy dissipation.". This adheres strictly to the governing invariant of Unitary Operations and Reversibility.

options.text: The system remains completely unchanged because Unitary Operations and Reversibility acts as an invariant identity operator without state transitions.
options.causalRationale: Misconception: Assumes operations produce zero observable effect, ignoring active transformation.

options.text: The state diverges uncontrollably because boundary conditions are violated immediately.
options.causalRationale: Reasoning Slip: Assumes instability without verifying whether mathematical bounds are preserved.

hintLadder.level3WorkedExample: "Worked Solution: Unitary operators U satisfy U dagger U = I, preserving the inner product <psi|phi> between all states. If two distinct states both collapsed to |0>, their distinctness would be destroyed, violating inner product conservation and unitarity."
